title: Seq workflow plan
description: The plan a model returned and seqc accepted for one workflow.

steps.description: One entry per step, in source order.

index.description: 1-based position; the C function is seq_step_<index>.

outputs.description: Files the program declares it will produce.

final.description: Whether this is a result rather than an intermediate file.

dependencies.description: Libraries the plan needs. Only libc, libm, and seqrt are accepted.
